title: Bhakti Movement
subject: History (CDS/NDA)

blocks.heading: 🙏 The Bhakti Movement
blocks.intro: A medieval socio-religious reform movement preaching personal devotion to God as the path to salvation, bypassing priests and caste barriers.

blocks.heading: 1. Origins & Schools
bullets: Originated in South India (7th-9th century) led by **Alvars** (Vaishnavite saints) and **Nayanars** (Shaivite saints).
Spread to North India in the 14th century by **Ramananda**.
Saguna School (Worshipped God with Form): **Mirabai:** Devoted to Krishna; composed Bhajans in Rajasthani/Braj.
Nirguna School (Worshipped Formless God): **Kabir:** Disciple of Ramananda. Opposed rituals, caste system, idol worship. Expressed ideas in *Dohas* (couplets) compiled in *Bijak*.

formulas: Alvars: Vishnu | Nayanars: Shiva | Ramcharitmanas: Tulsidas | Kirtans: Chaitanya
